question: The Chapekar Brothers (Damodar, Balkrishna, and Vasudeo) are remembered for assassinating a British official in response to injustices during the plague epidemic in which Indian city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pune**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The **Chapekar Brothers**—Damodar, Balkrishna, and Vasudeo—were Indian freedom fighters who are remembered for their revolutionary activities against British rule.

• They assassinated **W.C. Rand**, the British Plague Commissioner, on **22 June 1897**, in **Pune**, Maharashtra.

• This act was carried out in response to the oppressive measures and atrocities committed by British officials during the **bubonic plague epidemic** in Pune.

• The British administration’s handling of the plague outbreak involved invasive house inspections, forced evacuations, and harassment of Indian women, which angered the local population and the Chapekar Brothers.
